WingFoil-Version: 0.3.1 (unknown)

Give each task a stable id, usable wherever a title is

Each task gets an id from a per-list counter (task-1, task-2, ...), which
never goes back, so ids are unique within a list and not reused after a
removal. The list gets get(id); find, complete, reopen, rename, tag,
untag and remove accept an id as well as a title, with the id tried first.
